title: New to Canada: your first tax return
engine: Master timeline = the narration. voice: Voice: ElevenLabs Grady (via Higgsfield), the series voice. Post: silence trim, loudnorm −14 LUFS, 48 kHz. Music bed (tools/music.py, mood work) at −24 LUFS, sidechain-ducked; final mix −14 LUFS, AAC 192k.
